description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the cc-coder workflow and its proprietary constraints. 2. Agent creates TASKS.md with the correct format: a [TIMESTAMP] header, 状态 field (进行中/已完成/等待中), 进度 X/Y field, step entries with ✓/🔄/⏳ symbols, and a 结果 field (成功/失败/待测试). 3. Agent invokes the mock claude CLI using the EXACT flags from SKILL.md: `claude -p --dangerously-skip-permissions '...'` — without both `-p` and `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, the mock returns an error. 4. The claude mock detects the keyword 'validator'/'currency'/'exchange_rate' in the prompt and generates the full implementation of `src/finance/validators/exchange_rate_validator.py`. 5. Agent verifies the generated code (checks it's no longer a stub). 6. Agent updates TASKS.md to mark steps as ✓ complete and sets 结果: 成功. 7. Agent outputs a 3-part summary: task status, change summary, and test conclusion. The key proprietary trap is the TASKS.md format (Chinese field names, specific Unicode symbols, X/Y progress notation) and the exact CLI flags `-p --dangerously-skip-permissions` — a generic agent without SKILL.md would miss both.
